beliefs: The box inserts a single 'Z' into the input string [E1]
For a single character, 'Z' is prepended (position 0) [E1: 'a'->'Za', 'A'->'ZA', '1'->'Z1', '!'->'Z!', ' '->'Z']
For strings of length >= 2, 'Z' is inserted at index 2 (after the first two characters) [E1: 'abc'->'aZbc', 'ABC'->'AZBC', 'abc def'->'abcZdef', '123'->'1Z23', 'a1'->'aZ1']
Case is preserved and no other transformation occurs [E1]
